summary: Siuslaw forest lookout on Bell Mountain, Tillamook County: towers from 1925 on, both gone before 1963. No source describes the summit today.

facts.design: Wooden pole towers: 70 ft in 1925 and 1934 reports; an 80 ft tower with a 10x10 ft house reported in 1934
facts.status_note: Both towers gone before 1963 per the register; no source describes what remains on the summit today

corrections.why: No source gives 7.3 m. The register gives a 15 ft tower (1935) and an 80 ft tower (1936); newspapers give 70 ft (1925, 1934) and an 80 ft tower (1934).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's own Tillamook page gives FFLOS US 669, which is used here. The brief's source list also pointed to a separate Douglas County Bell Mountain page, which is not used.

notes_for_editor: The register and Oregon Lookouts disagree on the tower sequence (1925 and 1934 newspapers vs 1935 and 1936 register and Rex's page); the story gives both and does not choose. The brief's source_pages includes the Douglas County Bell Mountain page, a different site, and it should be removed from this record. A firelookout.org directory row seen in search (not fetched) pairs this site with FFLOS US 761, which is the Douglas County number. One search found no current description of the site; access is not stated in any source read. No photos added.
